title: urginavia altissima
intro: Urginavia altissima, commonly known as Mexican chamomile, is a plant native to Mexico and Central America. It is known for its soothing and calming properties, which make it a popular herbal remedy for stress, anxiety, and insomnia. The health benefits of Urginavia altissima include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and terpenoids, which exert sedative, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic effects.
